title: CloudScale Q3 Product Launch Announcement
original_text: Introducing CloudScale: The #1 cloud hosting provider with guaranteed 100% uptime SLA, fully immune to outages! Our revolutionary quantum engine makes traditional AWS and Google Cloud totally obsolete. Act now and get our cheap starter tier for only $9.99/mo! Contact our sales ninja today to destroy your competitors!

findings.message: Never claim 100% uptime; our maximum SLA commitment is 99.9%.
findings.evidence_quote: CloudScale provides an enterprise availability SLA of 99.9% uptime for Tier-1 workloads.

findings.message: Avoid 'cheap' to maintain premium luxury positioning.
findings.evidence_quote: Avoid diminutive or budget terminology such as 'cheap' or 'bargain'.
